subscriptions.err_bill_rebilled.en: {ref} can't bill again. It was taken off {agreement} for {start} to {end}, and that period is now billed on {newer}. Issuing {ref} as well would bill the period twice.

subscriptions.err_bill_reopened.en: {ref} can't bill again. Its period on {agreement}, {start} to {end}, was reopened, so the next document for that period bills it. Use Generate due on the agreement to bill the period.

subscriptions.err_period_draft.en: The document for this period, {ref}, is back in draft. Finalize {ref} to bill the period, or use Reopen on its row in the periods list to bill it on a new document.
